definitions.explanation: Considered in relation or comparison to something else; not absolute.

examples.japanese: {相対的|そうたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Relatively speaking, it can be called a success.

examples.japanese: {相対的|そうたいてき}な⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相対的|そうたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。

notes:
{相対的|そうたいてき} is a na-adjective meaning relative or comparative—judged in relation to something else rather than absolutely.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {相対的|そうたいてき}な + noun
- Adverbial: {相対的|そうたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (relatively)
⟦{相対|そうたい}→相対：13713_soutai⟧ (relativity) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix making na-adjectives)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相対的|そうたいてき}な⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: relative evaluation
- {相対的|そうたいてき}な⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧: relative value
- {相対的|そうたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧: relatively speaking
- {相対的|そうたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧: relatively cheap

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{絶対的|ぜったいてき}→絶対的：05849_zettaiteki⟧ (absolute) is the opposite—describing things that are complete or unconditional.

USAGE:
Often used in academic, business, or analytical contexts when comparing options or evaluating things in context.
